content: This document provides a comprehensive list of dental organizations from various countries around the world. Below are the details of these organizations, categorized by country: Albania The Albanian Dental Association is the primary professional organization representing dental practitioners in Albania. Andorra The Collegiate Body of Odontologists and Stomatologists in Andorra oversees the professional standards and practices of dental professionals in the country. Angola The Angolan National Association of Stomatology Technicians supports the development and regulation of stomatology professionals in Angola. Argentina The Confederación Odontológica de la República Argentina (Argentine Dental Confederation) is the leading organization for dental professionals in Argentina. Armenia The Armenian Dental Association represents the interests of dental practitioners in Armenia. Australia The Australian Dental Association Inc. is the national body for dentists in Australia, promoting oral health and professional standards. Austria The Österreichische Zahnärztekammer (Austrian Dental Chamber) is the official regulatory and professional body for dentists in Austria. Azerbaijan The Azerbaijan Stomatological Association, the Azeri Orthodontists Society, and the Azerbaijan Private Dentist Association collectively represent various aspects of dental practice in Azerbaijan. Bahamas The Bahamas Dental Association is the professional organization for dentists in the Bahamas. Bahrain The Bahrain Dental Society supports the professional development of dentists in Bahrain. Bangladesh The Bangladesh Dental Society is the primary organization for dental professionals in Bangladesh. Belarus The Belarusian Stomatological Association represents the interests of dental practitioners in Belarus. Belgium Belgium has several dental organizations, including Chambres Syndicales Dentaires, Société de Médecine Dentaire, and Verbond der Vlaamse Tandartsen, which cater to different linguistic and regional groups. Benin The Association des Chirurgiens-Dentistes du Bénin represents dental surgeons in Benin. Bolivia The Colegio de Odontólogos de Bolivia is the national organization for dental professionals in Bolivia. Bosnia & Herzegovina The Dental Association of Bosnia & Herzegovina oversees the professional standards of dentists in the country. Botswana The Botswana Dental Association represents the interests of dental practitioners in Botswana. Brazil Brazil has numerous dental organizations, including the Associação Brasileira de Odontologia (Brazilian Dental Association), Conselho Federal de Odontologia (Federal Council of Dentistry), and Sociedade Brasileira de Estomatologia e Patologia Oral (Brazilian Society of Stomatology and Oral Pathology), among others. Bulgaria The Association of Dentists in Bulgaria and the Association Médicale Scientifique Républicaine de Stomatologie are the primary dental organizations in Bulgaria. Burkina Faso The Association des Chirurgiens-Dentistes du Burkina represents dental surgeons in Burkina Faso. Cambodia The Cambodian Dental Association is the professional body for dentists in Cambodia. Cameroon The Association Nationale des Odonto-Stomatologistes du Cameroun represents dental professionals in Cameroon. Canada Canada has several dental organizations, including the Canadian Dental Association, the Canadian Academy of Pediatric Dentistry, and the Canadian Association of Orthodontists, among others. Chile The Colegio de Cirujano Dentistas de Chile is the national organization for dental surgeons in Chile. China The Chinese Stomatological Association is the leading dental organization in China. Chinese Taipei The Chinese Taipei Association for Dental Sciences represents dental professionals in Taiwan. Colombia The Federación Odontológica Colombiana (Colombian Dental Federation) is the primary organization for dentists in Colombia. Costa Rica Costa Rica has multiple dental organizations, including the Colegio de Cirujanos Dentistas de Costa Rica and the Facultad Odontologica at the Universidad de Costa Rica. Côte d'Ivoire The Association des Odonto-Stomatologistes de Côte d'Ivoire represents dental professionals in Côte d'Ivoire. Croatia The Croatian Dental Chamber and the Croatian Dental Society are the main organizations for dental practitioners in Croatia. Cuba The Sociedad Cubana de Estomatología is the national dental organization in Cuba. Cyprus The Cyprus Dental Association represents the interests of dental professionals in Cyprus. Czech Republic The Czech Dental Chamber is the regulatory and professional body for dentists in the Czech Republic. Democratic Republic of the Congo The Association Nationale des Chirurgiens-Dentistes represents dental surgeons in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Denmark Denmark has organizations such as the Association of Public Health Dentists in Denmark and the Danish Dental Association. Dominican Republic The Asociación Odontológica Dominicana is the primary dental organization in the Dominican Republic. Egypt The Egyptian Dental Association represents dental professionals in Egypt. Estonia The Estonian Dental Association is the professional body for dentists in Estonia. Ethiopia The Ethiopian Dental Professionals Association supports the development of dentistry in Ethiopia. Fiji The Fiji Dental Association represents dental practitioners in Fiji. Finland The Finnish Dental Association is the national organization for dentists in Finland. France The Association Dentaire Française is the leading dental organization in France. Gabon The Association Nationale des Odontostomatologistes du Gabon represents dental professionals in Gabon. Gambia The Gambia Medical and Dental Association oversees the professional standards of dentists in Gambia. Georgia The Georgian Stomatological Association represents dental practitioners in Georgia. Germany Germany has organizations such as the German Dental Association and the Bundeszahnärztekammer. Ghana The Ghana Dental Association is the professional body for dentists in Ghana. Greece Greece has organizations such as the Hellenic Dental Association and the Stomatological Society of Greece. Guyana The Guyana Dental Association is located at 125 Carmichael Street, South Cummingsburg, Georgetown, Guyana. Haiti The Association Dentaire Haïtienne represents dental professionals in Haiti. Hong Kong Hong Kong has organizations such as the Faculty of Dentistry at the University of Hong Kong, the Hong Kong Dental Association, and the Dental Council of Hong Kong. Hungary The Hungarian Dental Association is the national organization for dentists in Hungary. Iceland The Icelandic Dental Association represents dental professionals in Iceland. India India has several dental organizations, including the Indian Dental Association, the Indian Orthodontic Society, and the Dental Council of India. Indonesia The Indonesian Dental Association is the primary organization for dental professionals in Indonesia. Iran The Iranian Dental Association represents the interests of dental practitioners in Iran. Iraq The Iraqi Dental Association is the professional body for dentists in Iraq. Ireland Ireland has organizations such as the Irish Dental Association and the Dental Health Foundation. Israel The Israel Dental Association represents dental professionals in Israel. Italy Italy has organizations such as the Associazione Italiana Odontoiatri and the Associazione Nazionale Dentisti Italiani. Japan The Japan Dental Association is the leading organization for dental professionals in Japan. Jordan The Jordan Dental Association represents the interests of dental practitioners in Jordan. Kazakhstan The Kazakhstan Stomatological Association is the primary dental organization in Kazakhstan. Kenya The Kenya Dental Association represents dental professionals in Kenya. Korea The Korean Dental Association is the national organization for dentists in South Korea. Kyrgyzstan The Dental Association of the Kyrgyz Republic represents dental practitioners in Kyrgyzstan. Latvia The Latvian Dental Association is the professional body for dentists in Latvia. Lebanon The Lebanese Dental Association represents dental professionals in Lebanon. Lithuania The Lithuanian Dental Chamber is the regulatory body for dentists in Lithuania. Luxembourg The Cercle des Médecins-Dentistes du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg represents dental professionals in Luxembourg. Macedonia Macedonia has organizations such as the Macedonian Dental Association and the Dental Chamber of Macedonia. Malaysia The Malaysian Dental Association is the professional body for dentists in Malaysia. Mali The Association des Odonto-Stomatologistes du Mali (AOSMA) represents dental professionals in Mali. Malta The Malta Association of Dental Students supports dental education and professional development in Malta. Mauritius The Mauritius Dental Association represents dental practitioners in Mauritius. Mexico The Asociación Dental Mexicana is the national organization for dentists in Mexico. Miscellaneous Global organizations such as the FDI World Dental Federation, the American Veterinary Dental College, and the European Veterinary Dental College also contribute to the field of dentistry. Moldova The Public Academy of Dentistry of the Republic of Moldova represents dental professionals in Moldova. Mongolia The Mongolian Dental Association is the professional body for dentists in Mongolia. Morocco The Association Marocaine de Prévention Bucco-Dentaire (AMPBD) promotes oral health in Morocco. Myanmar The Myanmar Dental Association represents dental professionals in Myanmar. Namibia The Namibian Dental Association is the professional body for dentists in Namibia. Nepal The Nepal Dental Association represents dental practitioners in Nepal. Netherlands The Netherlands has several dental organizations, including the Associatie Nederlandse Tandartsen (ANT) and the Nederlandse Maatschappij tot Bevordering der Tandheelkunde (NMT). New Zealand The New Zealand Dental Association is the national organization for dentists in New Zealand. Niger The Association des Chirurgiens-Dentistes du Niger represents dental surgeons in Niger. Nigeria The Nigerian Dental Association is the professional body for dentists in Nigeria. Norway The Norwegian Dental Association represents dental professionals in Norway. Pakistan The Pakistan Dental Association is the national organization for dentists in Pakistan. Panama The Asociación Odontológica Panameña is the primary dental organization in Panama. Paraguay The Federación Odontológica del Paraguay represents dental professionals in Paraguay. Peru The Colegio Odontológico del Perú is the national organization for dentists in Peru. Philippines The Philippines has numerous dental organizations, including the Philippine Dental Association, the Philippine Academy of General Dentistry, and the Philippine Society of Periodontology. This list highlights the global network of dental organizations dedicated to advancing the field of dentistry and promoting oral health worldwide.
